method.method_draft: Let \(\theta_r\) be the ray angle inside the core measured from the fiber axis. At the entrance facet, Snell's law gives \(1\cdot\sin\theta_i=n_1\sin\theta_r\). For just-guided propagation, the ray hits the core-cladding boundary exactly at the critical angle: \(90^\circ-\theta_r=\theta_c\), with \(\sin\theta_c=n_2/n_1\). Hence \(\sin\theta_r=\sin(90^\circ-\theta_c)=\cos\theta_c=\sqrt{1-(n_2/n_1)^2}\). Substitute into Snell's law: \(\sin\theta_i=n_1\sqrt{1-(n_2/n_1)^2}=\sqrt{n_1^2-n_2^2}=\sqrt{0.29}\), so \(\theta_i\approx32.58^\circ\).
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示：入射光从左侧自由空间射向光纤端面，θ_i 标为相对于端面法线的入射角；光纤中间层为纤芯 core，折射率 n1，上下为包层 cladding，折射率 n2。推理：令 θ_r 为光进入纤芯后相对于光纤轴的折射角。端面处由 Snell 定律：1·sin θ_i = n1·sin θ_r。刚好能被导引的极限条件是光线在纤芯-包层界面处的入射角等于临界角 θ_c。因为界面法线与光纤轴垂直，所以界面入射角为 90° - θ_r，因此 90° - θ_r = θ_c。临界角满足 sin θ_c = n2/n1 = 1.4/1.5。于是 sin θ_r = cos θ_c = sqrt(1 - (n2/n1)^2)。代入 Snell 定律得 sin θ_i = n1 sqrt(1 - (n2/n1)^2) = sqrt(n1^2 - n2^2) = sqrt(1.5^2 - 1.4^2) = sqrt(0.29) ≈ 0.5385。故 θ_i = arcsin(0.5385) ≈ 32.58°。
